title: The problem's map edited in DCLab Code's card, as on DCLab's own page
request: The owner's goal: every agentic system of DCLab R&D works behind DCLab Code's chat with the same capabilities. v1.41 left the problem's map read-only in the card; a wrong part meant leaving the chat.
plan: read R&D's map edit rules (draft/map.py EDIT_KEYS, home.html mapAct and mapMerge)
a map_edit answer with only each edit's fields
the card's map with Remove, Merge into, Add a part, Confirm, Draw it again
tests, a check against a real rules-only R&D, review

decisions.decision: the card sends only each edit's own fields and lets R&D's validator judge the map
decisions.why: the map's soundness rules live in dclab_core; a second copy here would drift

decisions.decision: the family list is copied from home.html with its source named; the server checks only its shape
decisions.why: R&D refuses an unknown family with its reason, so a stale copy cannot write a wrong map

change: dclab-code c2c7f33: server/dclab_person.js (map_edit), web/draft.js (drawMap, act returns the result), server/app.js (record: a title only for add), web/style.css, tests, docs/PARITY_PLAN.md.

findings.defect: a merge's ignored title was recorded as words the person said
findings.scenario: a map_edit merge carrying a title field: the record kept it as the person's text
findings.cause: the recorded text took the first string field of any answer
findings.fix: the title is recorded only for an add
findings.test: server test: the merge records no text

measurements.name: real R&D check
measurements.gate: add, merge and confirm reach R&D and its refusals reach the card
measurements.result: rules-only R&D on a scratch workspace: add, merge, confirm done; removing the last part refused 409 'a map keeps at least one part'

measurements.name: sync-check
measurements.result: 18 of 18 agents reached, in sync with R&D 3c9a605e on GitHub

outcome: The problem's map is changed from the chat exactly as on DCLab's page; nothing of the Home agent's conversation needs DCLab's page now except connecting a database or a bucket, whose credentials stay on its server.
lessons: Record only the words a person typed for that action, never a field the action ignores.
risks: databases and buckets are still connected on DCLab's page
